gate: LCSP Origin / Source-Compatible Levi-Civita Morphism Gate

tangent_theorem.metric_condition: dot K_j - O_ij^T dot K_i O_ij + [Omega_ij,K_j] = 0, Omega_ij=O_ij^T dot O_ij in so(3)
tangent_theorem.continuum_torsion_condition: dot T = D_omega dot e + dot omega wedge e = 0
tangent_theorem.discrete_solder_condition: derivative of transported solder-loop closure equals zero

local_source_classification.boundary: rank/nullity result is for this explicit anisotropic three-qubit baseline and local-Pauli source class, not a universal dimension theorem

solder_lift_nonuniqueness.theorem: PGRL fixes the state tangent but does not select dot xi/e. The same dot rho and dot O admit torsion-preserving and torsion-breaking solder lifts unless an additional source-solder law is supplied.

integrability_obstruction.meaning: Even a source direction lying in the first-order LC tangent kernel at the chosen point need not generate a finite flow that remains in the sector.

isotropic_special_point.meaning: At isotropic BKM points first-order LC tangency can be automatic by symmetry while the same PGRL source leaves the sector at second order. First-order tangency is necessary, not sufficient.

source_current_audit.source_current_type: ledger scalar/current balance div J + C = 0, plus observer/source balance conditions
LC_tangent_type: edge metric/transport tangent: dot K_j-O^T dot K_i O+[Omega,K_j]=0
continuum torsion tangent: D_omega dot e + dot omega wedge e = 0
source_current_audit.missing_fields: Neither PGRL nor the archived scalar/current balance law supplies a theorem for the required joint dot O and dot xi/e lift that enforces the LC tangent equations.
source_current_audit.conclusion: source-current compatibility and PGRL do not imply LCSP by type; an additional source-compatible geometry lift is required.

missing_law.name: SCLL — Source-Compatible Levi-Civita Lift
missing_law.statement: For every allowed source/provenance deformation in the LC sector, jointly lift its state tangent to transport and solder/coframe tangents satisfying the metric and torsion tangency equations, and require this tangent distribution to integrate to finite LC-preserving source flows.
missing_law.relation_to_LCSP: SCLL is the infinitesimal/integrability content needed to realize the finite LCSP law for source operations.

next_gate.name: LCSP Integrability / Source Superselection Algebra Gate
next_gate.question: Classify source generators whose PGRL vector fields are tangent to the LC sector at every point of a connected sector, not merely at one state. Test closure under source addition/commutator/composition. If the globally tangent source set forms a nontrivial algebra, that is the candidate Einstein-sector source superselection algebra; if it collapses to gauge/trivial sources, record the no-go.
